description: I strongly advocate upholding our American constitutional rights, particularly free speech and the Second Amendment's protection of law-abiding citizens' right to own and carry firearms for personal defense or sportsmanship. There's a concerning trend in our society to silence dissenting voices, termed "cancel culture," which threatens our freedom of speech. Suppressing free expression could lead us down a dangerous path akin to the government control seen in Russia today.
title: Constitutional Rights | DeCaprio 4 CT 48th
